verbalization: The visible evidence suggests that Astersaponin F may interact with the EZH2/SUZ12/EED complex through a series of intermediate targets. The compound is directly linked to the dual serine/threonine and tyrosine protein kinase, which in turn is targeted by multiple compounds, including Npc115753 and Ethyl 3-(methylthio)propionate. These intermediates all ultimately target the EZH2/SUZ12/EED complex, indicating a potential pathway through which Astersaponin F could influence this complex. The scores from the different paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, with varying degrees of support from each target. The evidence highlights a possible mechanism involving the modulation of a protein kinase that serves as a bridge to the EZH2/SUZ12/EED complex. However, the exact nature of the interaction and the role of the intermediate targets remain areas of further investigation.
